results.description:
Willpower is not enough against social media algorithms!

That’s why I made one sec:

one sec adds friction to distracting apps to make them less appealing…long-term!

This principle works really well: we have gained scientific evidence in numerous research studies with the Max-Planck Institute, with the German and Danish government, and in dozens more scientific collaborations:

one sec has incredible effects on your screen time: app usage drops by 57% on average!

…just read our App Store reviews or try it for yourself if you don’t believe me (…you should really try it)!


How is one sec different from Screen Time limits or app blockers?
- one sec DELAYS access to distracting apps instead of blocking apps completely – that’s an important difference psychologically.
- This way, we solve the screen time problem at its roots: long-term & sustainably!
- one sec is always on, and makes using social media just slightly more annoying…so you’ll end up using it only when you actually have a reason!


Which apps can I use with one sec?
- You can set up one sec with any app you’d like to use less / more intentional.
- Most popular use-cases are: social media, games, video streaming, dating, stock/coin trading, adult content.
- Using one sec with one app of your choice if completely free, for more you’ll need to purchase one sec pro (we also need to finance development of our app!).


What if I get stuck scrolling?
- No worries, one sec offers a Doom Scroll Emergency Brake: We call it Re-Intervention.
- After a set time (e.g. 5 minutes) you’ll be kicked out of social media, and you’ll have to go through an intervention again to unlock more time.


Where can I learn more about the scientific background of one sec?
→ https://one-sec.app/research


Can I use one sec to interrupt access to websites as well?
→ Yes, one sec offers a free Safari extension as well.


How does one sec work technically?
- one sec uses Shortcuts Automation to toggle a deep breath animation whenever you open one of the configured apps (Instagram, Twitter, YouTube…).
- This breaks unconscious social media habits short-term (literally, as soon as you have set it up) and even helps long-term by adding more friction when opening these apps.


Integrations:
- Structured: one sec blocks apps during unfinished tasks.
- LENGO: learn vocabulary to unlock social media.


I developed one sec for myself in 2020…and it worked so well I decided to upload it to the App Store.

Especially for people with ADHD one sec is a great tool to gain back control for incredible focus and concentration.

– Frederik

Get therapy on demand:
Interactive Cognitive Behavioral Therapy lessons help you learn new skills you can use in everyday situations to support your recovery (2).

Strengthen coping strategies:
Questions at the end of each lesson help you remember important ideas and practice skills to stay in treatment (2).

Earn rewards:
Use an evidence-based rewards system designed to support your recovery and treatment (2).

Track your cravings and triggers:
Record substance use, cravings, and triggers with just a tap, so you and your therapist or doctor can better understand how you’re doing (2).

Recovery can be a challenging, ongoing process - especially in between therapy sessions, when you may not be able to access a counselor or doctor but still need support.

RESET® is a 12-week prescription digital therapeutic for patients with substance use disorder, who are currently enrolled in outpatient treatment under the supervision of a clinician. RESET® is the first FDA-authorized treatment shown to increase abstinence and retention over the 12-week trial duration (1,2).

Important Safety Information

Warnings/precautions: Do not use RESET® to communicate any emergency, urgent or critical information. RESET® does not include features that can send alerts or warnings to your clinician. If you have feelings or thoughts of harming yourself or others, please dial 911 or go to the nearest emergency room. RESET® is intended for patients whose primary language is English or Spanish, who have access to a compatible tablet or smartphone and are familiar with the use of smartphone applications (apps). You should be able to upload data periodically, i.e. have internet/wireless connection access. RESET® requires you to enter a user name and password prior to use. Please do not share your user name and password with others. RESET® may contain and transmit protected health information and/or personally identifiable information. RESET® is not intended to be used as stand-alone therapy for substance use disorder (SUD) and does not replace care by your provider. RESET® is not a substitute for your medications. You should continue to take your medications as directed by your provider.

The long-term benefit of treatment with RESET® on abstinence has not been evaluated in studies lasting beyond 12 weeks (90 days) in the SUD population. The ability of RESET® to prevent potential relapse after treatment discontinuation has not been studied. The safety and effectiveness of RESET® has not been established in patients enrolled in opioid treatment programs. Please see the Patient Brief Summary Instructions for RESET® in the app.

results.description:
How many times did your thumb scroll today?

You probably don’t even remember what you were looking at ten minutes ago.
Time slips away, and by the next morning you’re thinking,
“Why did I waste it again?”

It’s time to stop pretending.
It’s time to face reality.

“Digital Detox Timer” is a no-escape digital detox app.
The moment you touch or move your phone, time stops.

Every second you keep your eyes off the screen,
your focus becomes visible.
Regret it again tomorrow — or face it right now.
The choice is yours.





■ The More You Leave Your Phone, the More Time Moves
The rules are simple.

Start the game, and the timer begins.
Touch or move your phone — and the timer instantly stops.

That means:
• Leave your phone on the desk  
• Don’t look at the screen  
• Don’t pick it up  

Only the time you truly stay away from your phone is recorded as focus time.

“Don’t touch it, time moves.”
“Touch it, time stops.”

This brutally simple mechanic exposes unconscious phone addiction
and naturally pulls your attention back to the real world.





■ What It Means to Truly Focus
While the timer is running, you’ll naturally start asking yourself:
“What should I do right now?”

• Read a book  
• Study  
• Focus on work  
• Think  
• Do absolutely nothing  

Anything is fine.
What matters is directing your attention to something other than your phone.

It may start with just a few minutes.
But over time, your ability to focus will grow.

This isn’t a detox that forces restraint.
It’s about realizing — almost without noticing —
that you’ve stepped away from your phone.





■ Test Your Focus on the Global Leaderboard
Your recorded focus time is reflected in a global ranking.

Country, age, and background don’t matter.
Only one thing counts:
how long you stayed away from your phone.

• How focused were you today?  
• Did you beat yesterday’s time?  
• Where do you rank in the world?  

Turn focus into a game.
Compete with others — or simply with yourself.
How far you go is up to you.





■ Your Focus Time Is Saved as History
All focus sessions are saved automatically.

You can look back and see:
• How long you focused  
• How you felt  
• What you worked on  

With the memo feature, you can also record insights from each session.

“I focused well while reading today.”
“I couldn’t stay focused in the afternoon.”
“Ambient sounds really helped.”

By reviewing these records, you’ll discover your own ideal focus style.





■ Create a Focus-Friendly Environment with Ambient Sounds
The app includes multiple ambient sounds.

• When you want silence  
• When you need to block distractions  
• When you want a calm atmosphere  

Use it as focus background music to dive deeper into your work.

The sounds are subtle and unobtrusive,
designed to support your thinking — not interrupt it.





■ Works as a Desk Clock Too
With its simple design, the app also works as a desk clock.

• On your desk  
• By your bedside  
• Next to your workspace  

You can check the time without notifications or temptations.

“To avoid touching your phone, you leave your phone.”
That paradox is built into this app.




■ Ultra-Minimal Design
Everything unnecessary has been stripped away.

• No registration  
• No complicated settings  
• Start instantly  

Open the app and press start.
That’s it.

Because the goal isn’t to focus on the app —
it’s to focus on real life.





■ Recommended For
• Anyone who wants to reduce phone usage  
• People who want better focus  
• Students and professionals  
• Those starting digital detox  
• Anyone who wants a simple focus timer  
• People who like building habits through games  




■ One Last Thing
This app doesn’t take your time.

It gives your time back to you.

The moment you put your phone down,
your focus begins.

So — how many minutes can you focus today?
Give it a try.

results.description:
Most people don't lose hours to the feed because they're weak. They lose them because nothing has ever stood between the thought and the thumb.
Spark Break puts one rep there.
Ten squats, five slow exhales, or one honest sentence about what you're actually avoiding. Do it and the screen opens. Do it six times a day and you're not just scrolling less — you're stronger, calmer, and harder to distract. That's the whole system.
THREE ACTIONS, UNDER SIXTY SECONDS EACH
Move — ten squats, a few times an hour. Not a workout. Just meaningfully less sitting than the scroll would have cost you, confirmed by motion and step data.
Breathe — five slow exhales, right at the moment you're most wound up, before the anxious spiral finishes its sentence. Not meditation. Just enough of a pause that the feeling passes instead of feeding itself.
Focus — one sentence, typed or spoken, about the thing you're avoiding. Say it often enough and it stops being avoidable. That's repetition doing the job willpower usually fails at.
A TAPER, NOT A CLIFF
Week one measures. No limit at all — Spark Break learns your real baseline from your real days while you live normally.
Every week after, your daily target steps down ten percent. Never below the number you chose yourself: ninety, sixty, or forty-five minutes. If a week goes badly, the plan holds instead of pushing.
Roughly every fifty minutes on a protected app, the screen locks until one action is done. A few skips a day are built in, for when you genuinely can't stop.
NO RED ZEROS
Break a streak and Spark Break says "Day 1 again. Your best was 14." That's the entire response. No failure screens, no red numbers, no notification chasing you down about what you lost.
Shame is what sends people back to the feed. This app is built to not do that.
WHAT HAPPENS ON YOUR IPHONE STAYS ON YOUR IPHONE
Apple seals Screen Time data inside the app on your device. The apps you protect are stored as opaque tokens even we cannot read. Per-app usage is rendered by Apple's own view and never transmitted. Anything you type stays local. Motion readings confirm an action, then are discarded.
No account is required to use Spark Break. There is no sign-up, no email address, and nothing to look you up by.
WHAT SPARK BREAK WON'T DO
Calls, Messages, Maps, banking and health apps can never be shielded. Ever. And Spark Break can't protect itself from you — the app picker blocks that on purpose.
Spark Break needs Screen Time permission to know when you're deep in a session. Motion and Fitness permission is optional; decline it and movement actions are swapped for breathing ones.
Take the time back.

RESET-O® is a 12-week prescription digital therapeutic for patients with opioid use disorder who are in outpatient treatment. It provides cognitive behavioral therapy, as an adjunct to outpatient treatment that includes transmucosal buprenorphine and contingency management, for patients who are currently under the supervision of a clinician. RESET-O® is the only FDA-authorized prescription digital therapeutic that’s clinically proven to help people with opioid use disorder stay in treatment longer (1,2).

Important Safety Information

Warnings/precautions: Do not use RESET-O® to communicate any emergency, urgent or critical information. RESET-O® does not include features that can send alerts or warnings to your clinician. If you have feelings or thoughts of harming yourself or others, please dial 911 or go to the nearest emergency room. RESET-O® is intended for patients whose primary language is English or Spanish, who have access to a compatible tablet or smartphone and are familiar with the use of smartphone applications (apps). You should be able to upload data periodically, i.e., have internet/wireless connection access. RESET-O® requires you to enter a user name and password prior to use. Please do not share your user name and password with others. RESET-O® may contain and transmit protected health information and/or personally identifiable information. RESET-O® is not intended to be used as stand-alone therapy for Opioid Use Disorder (OUD) and does not replace care by your provider. RESET-O® is not a substitute for your medications. You should continue to take your medications as directed by your provider. 

The long-term benefit of RESET-O® has not been evaluated in studies lasting beyond 12 weeks (84 days) in the OUD population. The ability of RESET-O® to prevent potential relapse after therapy discontinuation has not been studied. Please see the Patient Brief Summary Instructions for RESET-O® in the app.
